title: MaximeRivest/riddle
claim: MaximeRivest/riddle — The diary of Tom Riddle for the reMarkable Paper Pro — write with your pen, the page drinks your ink and answers in a fl
why_good: Riddle is a diary app for the reMarkable Paper Pro that lets you write with your pen, then the page 'drinks' your ink, fades it, and an AI (OpenAI-compatible) writes back in a flowing handwritten style. It uses a full-screen takeover mode for instant ink and remembers past pages for context.
value: reMarkable Paper Pro owners who want a unique, handwriting-based AI journaling experience pay for the emotional satisfaction and novelty.
risk: reMarkable itself could release a similar feature, or the small market of Paper Pro owners may not be enough to sustain a business.

zh.claim: 为 reMarkable Paper Pro 用户提供一种用笔书写、AI 以手写体回复的魔法日记体验。
zh.hook: reMarkable Paper Pro 的用户想要一个 AI 伴侣，但希望保留纸上书写的质感，而不是在聊天框里打字。
zh.does: Riddle 是 reMarkable Paper Pro 上的日记应用，让你用笔书写，然后页面会“喝掉”你的墨水，淡出，AI（兼容 OpenAI）以流畅的手写体回复。它采用全屏接管模式实现即时墨水显示，并记住过去的页面以提供上下文。
zh.why_use: 它是唯一能将 reMarkable 的电子墨水屏变成魔法般、基于手写的 AI 界面的应用，避免了冰冷的聊天 UI。用笔书写并看到回复以你自己的笔迹出现，这种体验独特而令人愉悦。
zh.gap: 它需要 reMarkable Paper Pro 处于开发者模式并安装启动器，这对非技术用户来说是一个障碍；没有为普通用户提供简单的安装方式。
zh.counter: reMarkable 可能会原生添加类似的 AI 功能，或者出现更精致的应用；这是一个小众设备上的小众功能，用户基数很小。
zh.differentiator: 将其打包为 reMarkable Paper Pro 的一键安装，提供简单的设置向导，无需 SSH 或开发者模式知识。
zh.value: reMarkable Paper Pro 用户想要独特的、基于手写的 AI 日记体验，他们为情感满足和新奇感付费。
zh.risk: reMarkable 本身可能发布类似功能，或者 Paper Pro 用户的小众市场不足以支撑业务。
zh.why_good: Riddle 是 reMarkable Paper Pro 上的日记应用，让你用笔书写，然后页面会“喝掉”你的墨水，淡出，AI（兼容 OpenAI）以流畅的手写体回复。它采用全屏接管模式实现即时墨水显示，并记住过去的页面以提供上下文。

does: Riddle is a diary app for the reMarkable Paper Pro that lets you write with your pen, then the page 'drinks' your ink, fades it, and an AI (OpenAI-compatible) writes back in a flowing handwritten style. It uses a full-screen takeover mode for instant ink and remembers past pages for context.
why_use: It's the only app that turns the reMarkable's e-ink display into a magical, handwriting-based AI interface, avoiding the sterile chat UI. The gesture of writing and seeing a reply appear in your own handwriting is unique and delightful.
gap: No verified demand; the niche of AI-powered handwriting on reMarkable is unproven.
counter: reMarkable could add a similar AI feature natively, or a more polished app could emerge; it's a niche feature for a niche device, and the user base is small.
differentiator: Package it as a one-click install for the reMarkable Paper Pro, with a simple setup wizard that doesn't require SSH or developer mode knowledge.
hook: Owners of the reMarkable Paper Pro who want an AI companion with the feel of writing on paper, not typing into a chat box.
consumer_angle: An ordinary person could use it as a magical journaling experience, but it's currently a niche tool for reMarkable owners.
pick_reason: Fresh repo with stars but no behavioral evidence or quotes; the gap and wedge are unclear.
